sections.label: Class 1 expenditures unchanged
sections.summary: No change is proposed for Class 1 expenditures, including the President's salary and allowance.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To be clear, no change is proposed for Class 1 expenditures, that is to say, no change is proposed in this Motion to the President's salary and allowance.

sections.label: Class 2 staff salaries increase
sections.summary: Class 2 expenditures for the President's personal staff are proposed to increase from $6,696,700 to $7,318,000.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For Class 2 expenditures, which provide for the salaries of the President's personal staff, it is proposed to increase the sum from $6,696,700 to $7,318,000.

sections.label: Class 3 and Class 4 increases
sections.summary: Class 3 household expenses are proposed to rise from $3,342,200 to $4,542,000, and Class 4 from $550,000 to $1,288,000.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For Class 3 expenditures, which provide for the expenses of the household, it is proposed to increase the sum from $3,342,200 to $4,542,000.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For Class 4 expenditures, it is proposed to increase the sum from $550,000 to $1,288,000.
